messages.subject: Project Drake — final invoice query
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Unrelated to the current work — could someone confirm whether the final WC invoice on Project Drake (the supplier agreement we closed last year) has been settled? Our finance team is reconciling the year and can't find the remittance. No rush, just closing the books.

Thanks,
Priya
